Definition: to fail; by implication to wear out, decay (causatively, consume, spend)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to wear out, become old; 1a) (Qal) to wear out; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to wear out; 1b2) to wear out by use, use up completely; 1b3) to enjoy, use to the full
